description: Italian glossary of the game's own text (docs/modding/translation-handbook.md). terms: English term of glossary_en.json -> the Italian form used in every file. keep_latin: unused for a Latin-script language. style: the rules of voice and form.

style.address: Harry and Cybil: tu. Harry and Lisa: tu. Harry and Kaufmann: lei, both ways (also in the motel quarrel). Dahlia to everyone: tu, elevated and archaic (giunto, destarsi, celato); Harry to Dahlia: lei until the amusement park, tu in the last scene. Dahlia and Kaufmann: tu. Lisa to the doctor on the tape: lei. Alessa as a child to Dahlia: mammina; grown Alessa: mamma; Dahlia of herself: la mamma. Cheryl: papà. The UFO ending addresses the aliens in the plural (voi).
style.gender: Participles and adjectives carry the speaker's gender (svenuta, riuscita, stato): see the list of scenes in translation-handbook.md. Where the speaker is uncertain the line is worded without gender (map6_s01 'Ero in pensiero per te', 'si può sapere dov'eri?'; the motel diary uses avere-perfects only).
style.quotes: « » for the [ ] of the English; the dash is the character — (U+2014), which the English writes as '='; the ellipsis stays three dots.
style.item_in_sentence: an item name inside a sentence is lower case (proper names keep the capital) with its own article and a pronoun that agrees: 'C'è una <chiave di casa>. Prenderla?', 'Ho usato la <chiave di casa>.', 'Ho trovato uno <scontrino>.' The name inside the colour span equals the inventory name.
style.prompts: choices are infinitives: Prenderlo? Premere l'interruttore? Girare la valvola a sinistra.
style.narration: examinations are Harry's own thoughts, first person where a subject is needed (Ho usato, Non riesco a prenderla).
style.floors: floor numbers are kept as in the English (American counting), because the in-game maps use them.

terms.Key of [..]: Chiave «..» (spiriti); Chiave Leone / Boscaiolo / Spaventapasseri senza virgolette (202 px)
terms.Handgun / Hunting rifle / Shotgun: Pistola / Fucile da caccia / Fucile a pompa (proiettili per pistola, proiettili per fucile, cartucce a pallettoni)
terms.There is a X. Take it?: C'è un/una <x>. Prenderlo? / Prenderla? / Prenderli? / Prenderle?
